items.title: 44 states are aligned on one thing in their fight against prediction markets. It's about sports wagering
items.summary: The letter was sent as the public comment period for the CFTC's first proposed rule on prediction market regulation expired Monday evening.

items.title: Meta likely to highlight smart glasses, avoid social media policy on upcoming earnings call, Kalshi traders say
items.summary: Meta is set to report earnings after the market close Wednesday, and traders on prediction market platform Kalshi think the Instagram parent will use its conference call to highlight its Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses and push into the cloud market, while steering clear of social media policy debates.

items.title: The future of Wall Street is here as startups and brokers build AI agents to trade 24/7
items.summary: Imagine telling an AI agent how much risk you're willing to take, your retirement goals and when your kids will start college — then letting it manage your portfolio while you sleep.

items.title: Visa is cutting 7% of employees in efficiency push as AI reshapes work
items.summary: Visa , which runs the world's largest payments network, plans to cut about 7% of its workforce as CEO Ryan McInerney moves to streamline the company and invest more in growth areas, according to a memo confirmed by CNBC.
